podcast.body: Released in June 1983, this was the last official Bauhaus album to feature Peter Murphy. Its recording commenced while Peter was hospitalized with pneumonia, forcing the rest of the band to work on the album without him, and during this process, they found that things worked "very well without Peter." "The resulting album was called Burning from the Inside. And this was the last official Bajaos singer."

The rest of the band proceeded with the recording, discovering they could work effectively without him, which contributed to the band's internal divisions and eventual split. "The resulting album was called Burning from the Inside. And this was the last official Bajaus singer."
